title: Mobile Checkout and Buy Now Pay Later for WooCommerce: 7 Fixes Before Black Friday

linkedin.post:
Your ads worked. People are adding to cart. But the orders don't match the clicks.

Picture your shopper. They're on the sofa with one thumb free, ready to buy. Then checkout asks them to type a card number and make an account.

That's often where the sale slips away. The shopper already decided to buy, so there's nothing left to persuade. Adobe's 2026 forecast puts mobile at 57.4% of online holiday spend. Pay later is forecast at $21.3 billion, and 82% of it comes through mobile. Your busiest days get decided on a small screen.

Here are 5 things that make paying on a phone easier:

1️⃣ One-tap payment buttons at the top
Apple Pay, Google Pay and PayPal let people pay without typing a card number or address. Without them, your shopper types on glass and gives up. With them, paying takes seconds, not minutes.

2️⃣ Pay later shown near the price
Some shoppers see the price and quietly decide it's too much. A pay in four message beside it changes that moment. They see the real amount per payment and keep going.

3️⃣ Fewer form fields
Every box is a small tax on patience, and typing on a phone is slow. Do you really need a company name to ship a parcel? Remove what you don't need and the form feels shorter.

4️⃣ Checkout without making an account
Being asked to sign up right when they're ready to pay feels like a wall. Many shoppers just close the tab. Let them pay first and offer an account afterward.

5️⃣ A real test order on a real phone
Buy something from your own store on your own phone. Notice every spot where you hesitate. Your customers hesitate in the same places, and you'll see it before they do.

Most of these are small changes, not a rebuild. You can fix several this week.

When did you last buy from your own store on your phone?

instagram.caption:
🚨 Can a shopper finish paying on a phone?

Most holiday spend happens on mobile, and a checkout that feels fine on your desktop can lose people at every tap.

Here are 5 fixes to make before Black Friday:

1️⃣ Wallets at the top
Apple Pay and Google Pay skip the card number and the address.

2️⃣ BNPL near the price
Show the pay in four message on the product page and the cart.

3️⃣ Fewer fields
Hide or make optional anything you do not need to ship the order.

4️⃣ Guest checkout
Let shoppers pay first and create an account after.

5️⃣ Test orders on real phones
Use Safari on an iPhone and Chrome on an Android.

💡 The cheapest fix on the list is the one most stores skip: a real test order.
